message: As a busy parent, I often think about how to make any unexpected car situation feel like a little adventure instead of a hassle. This resource offers some great insights on what to keep in your car to stay prepared. I find that having a few essentials can turn a simple wait into a cozy moment with my kids—snacks, a good story, or even some fun games can make all the difference. What are your favorite ways to stay cozy and prepared on the road?
